summary: Session sandbox blocks mv/cp/rm on the .pending-x/ dot-dir. The tweet-broadcast skill's 'move posted file to .pending-x/sent/' step cannot complete from the agent session, so already-posted (and stale) source files linger in the active queue and re-trigger X duplicate-content 403s on every run.
note: 403s on these files are DUPLICATE-CONTENT rejections, NOT auth failures. POST OAuth works (2 tweets posted today). Do NOT rotate creds for this. This is distinct from the x-credential-blocker.json READ-tier 401 issue.

future_run_guidance: Read this file FIRST in tweet-broadcast. For any .pending-x/*.txt whose basename is in skip_source_files, do NOT call the X post API — it will 403 (duplicate) or publish stale numbers. Only post files NOT listed here.
operator_action_required: @_proxystudio: (a) have the dispatcher move posted files out of .pending-x/ host-side after each broadcast, or (b) grant the agent session write access to .pending-x/sent/ so the skill can complete its move step. Until fixed, the queue cannot self-clear.
